name: TES Dashboard
shortDescription: A modern dashboard for monitoring and managing federated Task Execution Service (TES) instances and workflow execution across cloud infrastructures.
description: TES Dashboard is a full-stack platform built for the ELIXIR Cloud ecosystem to provide centralized visibility and management of distributed TES infrastructure. It enables users to monitor federated TES nodes, submit computational tasks and workflows, track executions, inspect logs, and visualize network health from a single interface.
longDescription: The TES Dashboard brings distributed Task Execution Service infrastructure into a unified management interface. It provides real-time service monitoring, interactive federation topology visualization, task and workflow execution tracking, batch processing, node and instance management, middleware configuration, authentication, and network diagnostics. The platform supports CWL, Nextflow, and Snakemake workflows and is designed to operate across federated cloud environments.
problem: Federated cloud infrastructures can involve multiple TES instances, execution engines, workflows, and services that are difficult to monitor and manage from separate interfaces. Operators need a centralized view of infrastructure health, task execution, workflow progress, and network connectivity.
solution: Built a centralized TES management dashboard that connects federated TES instances and provides real-time visibility into service health, network topology, computational tasks, workflows, batch executions, logs, and infrastructure configuration.
features: CWL, Nextflow, and Snakemake workflow support
challenges: Monitoring distributed TES instances across a federation
Providing real-time service and execution status
Visualizing relationships between federated TES nodes
Managing asynchronous task and workflow execution
Designing a centralized interface for distributed infrastructure
results: Centralized monitoring of federated TES infrastructure
Real-time visibility into execution and service health
Interactive visualization of TES network topology
Support for CWL, Nextflow, and Snakemake workflows
